provisional_route.primary_finish: premium cel-painted webcomic with clear-line contour hierarchy and restrained painterly color
provisional_route.reason: The cel-painted arm is 4/4 on all six engineering dimensions and gives the strongest close-character continuity; its missing wide-action coverage is the next controlled test rather than an assumed strength.

chapter_cadence.wide_action_and_reveal: Use clear-line watercolor or clean graphic composition with restrained detail and a protected sky/wall field; validate the cel-painted finish on an exact P050 comparison before standardizing it.
chapter_cadence.medium_dialogue_and_deduction: Use the cel-painted finish with simplified backgrounds and one canonical lettering field.
chapter_cadence.tall_causal_action: Use the cel-painted/clear-line hybrid only when the complete action chain remains visible from hands through tool/lever to target.
chapter_cadence.small_object_insert: Use limited ink and flat color with a single causal object; suppress incidental environment detail.
chapter_cadence.transitions: Use clear-line watercolor with fewer rendered textures than c004/c005 and preserve role-order silhouettes.

provisional_route.continuity_mechanism: P050 dual identity plus P040 Sigrid identity, explicit text hair/wardrobe invariants, and P036 composition-only usage. Include text-only controls when reference dominance could reverse orientation.
provisional_route.lettering_rule: The exact normalized ComicPanelPlan safe zone is an input constraint and packet overlay; any overlap with a face, person, important hand, story object, or dense branch texture fails or warns before lettering.

next_high_information_experiment.minimum_scope: Complete the P050 style triangle with one cel-painted wide action candidate, then make only targeted composition repairs for c003/c007/c009 failure classes.
next_high_information_experiment.selection_gate: Do not standardize the primary finish until the wide cel-painted P050 candidate preserves role order, causal motion, hair/wardrobe, lettering clearance, and phone readability.

limitations: The built-in product exposed no model, endpoint, provider request ID, usage, cost, or deterministic seed.
Candidate counts per style are small and panel-role coverage is imbalanced.
The lower-density style frequently retained dense environment rendering and needs stronger prompt isolation.
No output is human accepted, commercially cleared, or promoted as an exact production base.
